title: [US] Agency Partner Onboard Guide
label: TIKTOK SHOP · PARTNER GUIDE
subtitle: Updated 2026-03-31
html:
TikTok Shop Partner Center（US Market) : https://partner.us.tiktokshop.com/

Onboarding Workflow

Step 1: Register an account

You can register an account with Email, Phone number (optional), and password. *Please note that the email address is critical and will be used to receive platform emails. Please make sure this is a real and valid email address.

Step 2: Choose a Role

  • "TikTok Shop Partner" (for TSP/CAP/TAP roles).
  • "Developer" (for ISV roles).

Step 3: Fill Out Company Details

Provide company entity info for platform review. Note: Please ensure that the company information provided is accurate. Once approved, the partner's entity information will be applied across all categories and finance-related information, and can not be modified. *Company information list:

Step 4: Choose Service Category

  • Target market: Defaults to US and non-editable in US L2L.
  • Service categories: Choose single/multiple categories via flat cards, where you can see category names and overviews

Step 5:Fill Out Details

  • Add category-specific information.
  • Please note that no more than three partners may be registered under the same company entity. Any additional submissions will result in your application being rejected

*Category information list: After successfully submitting your onboarding application, you will see this confirmation page.

Step 4: Apply and check review status

After delivering the applications, you can go to [My Account] ➤[Profile] ➤[ Company entity info] to check the company entity info and review status. Under the [Service category info] Tab, you can check the review status of each category's applications.

*Status of application

Status Action Demo
Approved For approved applications, you can view details or click "Edit" to modify related information
Rejected You can click[modify] to review rejected reasons and modify information
Pending Review Please kindly wait for the platform to review your applications

Note: You can also click "add category & market" on the profile page to apply another new category as needed.

*Experience For Existing Agency Partners

New Service Category for All Agencies

The service category upgrade will take effect from April 30. All existing partners might notice a slight difference in your system. ⚠️ Please note:

  • This upgrade would not affect any related feature usage according to the different partner types
  • From April 30th, new partners will be unable to register for the discontinued categories of ++Mass Recruiting, Mass Tutoring, and Paid Media++.
  • From June 5th, obtaining new authorization from sellers for the discontinued categories of ++Mass Recruiting, Mass Tutoring, and Paid Media++ will no longer be possible.

Together with the service category update, for the role switch button on other product pages, like payments and analytics pages... The role will reference the latest service category structure to retrieve the corresponding data.

Check the existing onboarding status and information

Your application status for each category will be kept the same as before. Your onboarding information will be integrated into a new user interface framework. You can view your entity information under the "Company Entity Info" section and access related category information and review statuses under the "Service Category Info" section. Please note: During the TTSPC upgrade, your onboarding application will be rejected, while the system will automatically generate another application under the same category. After the upgrade, your application will be processed. We appreciate your patience and kind understanding and apologize for any inconvenience caused.
